evidence: Frozen task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template's environment/Dockerfile (both sha256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1, matching manifest.json; `diff` empty), so it is template-controlled and must be preserved. Pinned: line 1 `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` (no --platform); line 9-11 `npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1` exact versions; apt lines 5-7 (`ca-certificates git procps sqlite3`) unpinned, which the workbook (check-dockerfiles.py) classes as a NOTE only. No pip, no nproc. Every runtime dependency pre-installed: the golden's only non-builtin requires across solution/ are require('express') and require('better-sqlite3') (others are node:fs/path/crypto/http/worker_threads and relative files); solution/app/package.json pins exactly express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1, matching the global install; line 3 `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules` matches the global npm root and the NODE_PATH that tests/test.sh passes through env -i (lines 104-106, 160-162). solve.sh only copies files and runs node built-ins (no npm/pip/apt at solve or run time). instruction.md line 13 ('Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages') and integration.md lines 3-4/18-19 tell the agent the same thing, so the declared world matches the built one. tests/Dockerfile installs the same two packages at the same versions (lines 16-22), so the runtime set is consistent across images. Assets staged: line 14 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` and line 15 `COPY assets/ /assets/`; both sources exist (environment/instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}, environment/assets/seed_data.json), which are exactly the /instructions and /assets paths instruction.md lines 11-15 name; line 16 `chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets`; lines 17-23 create /app, git-init it with only .gitkeep committed; WORKDIR /app. No COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/. task.toml has no [environment].docker_image, so this Dockerfile is the one built; build_timeout_sec=600. Indirect runtime evidence: raw-evidence-index entries (workspace.json sha256 7ae5b5c3..., server.log sha256 6752f461..., both re-verified) show the frozen golden starting ('[hireops] listening on 3000') with only NODE_PATH-provided express/better-sqlite3 in hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair, which installs the same pinned packages. Adversarial: (a) a broken app that needs an uninstalled package (e.g. ws, socket.io) would fail to start at grade time - that is correct behaviour, not a Dockerfile defect, and the brief forbids installing packages; (b) a conforming alternative using node:sqlite or other Node 22 built-ins also runs on this image; (c) better-sqlite3 has no compile toolchain in the slim agent image, but the build runs with public network and fetches the official prebuilt linux binary for Node 22 at image-build time - any failure would surface at build, never at run time. Residual note (not a defect, not elevated): no agent-image (environment/Dockerfile) build log is in the r12 raw-evidence index; the golden observations came from the verifier image. The row's skill procedure (quality-checks.md ###15) is a source inspection that this Dockerfile fully meets, and the bytes equal the shared template, so the missing build log is recorded rather than treated as a required measurement for this row. Base image is tag-pinned, not digest-pinned, per template; the workbook's pinning rule (check-dockerfiles.py) accepts this.
